vulnerability.name: USN-8398-3
vulnerability.description: USN-8398-1 fixed a vulnerability in nginx. The update caused a regression and was temporarily reverted in USN-8398-2. This update introduces a complete fix for CVE-2026-49975.  We apologize for the inconvenience.  Original advisory details:   It was discovered that nginx incorrectly handled certain cookie headers in  the HTTP/2 implementation. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue  to cause nginx to consume excessive resources, resulting in a denial of  service.

statements.status_notes: nginx could be made to consume excessive resources if it received specially crafted network traffic.
